keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Marc Pubill (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Cristian Romero (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Atletico Madrid 0, Real Madrid 0.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Koke replaces Marc Pubill.
Second Half begins Atletico Madrid 0, Real Madrid 0.
Denzel Dumfries (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card.
Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) is shown the red card.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 1, Real Madrid 0. Alejandro Grimaldo (Atletico Madrid) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Antonio Rüdiger replaces Arda Güler.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Yan Diomande replaces Vinícius Júnior.
Delay in match (Atletico Madrid).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 2, Real Madrid 0. Jonathan David (Atletico Madrid) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Giuliano Simeone with a cross.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Julián Alvarez replaces Jonathan David.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Ademola Lookman replaces Álex Baena.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Eduardo Camavinga replaces Aurélien Tchouaméni.
Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Bernardo Silva replaces Jude Bellingham.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Robin Le Normand replaces Cristian Romero.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Morten Hjulmand replaces Lee Kang-In.

Goal! Atletico Madrid 2, Real Madrid 1. Antonio Rüdiger (Real Madrid) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Bernardo Silva with a cross following a set piece situation.
